Your question isn’t here? Ask the people who ran a $2 billion retailer. Book a process call Book a process call Working with Duvo What is Duvo? Duvo is the Enterprise Execution OS: it maps how a process really runs from interviews with the people who do the work, then runs it with AI agents in the systems you already use. It was built by the team that ran a $2 billion retailer, and raised a $32 million Series A on 14 October 2026, led by Balderton Capital. The platform Our $32M Series A How long does it take to go live? Duvo goes live within 8 weeks on your existing systems. It starts with a two-week Enterprise trial that maps one of your processes. Process discovery Customer stories Which systems does Duvo work with? Duvo works inside the systems your team already uses, including SAP, Coupa and Outlook. The first process map needs no system access or integration. Platform integrations Is our data used to train AI models? No. Duvo does not train its own or third-party models on customer data. It holds SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 and supports GDPR requirements. Trust Center How is Duvo different from process mining? Process mining reads system logs. Duvo Clarity interviews the people who do the work, so it captures the emails, spreadsheets and judgement calls a log never records. Interviews take around 10 minutes and run in 177+ languages. Process mining vs AI-led process discovery Can I try Duvo? Yes, in two ways: a two-week Enterprise trial on one of your processes, guided by Duvo, or the self-serve Free plan (2 Clarity interviews and 0.05 DPU one-off). Book a process call Start free The mission What do you mean, the GDP of an employee? At Duvo, we see every employee as a unit of profit, not a unit of cost. A nation’s economy is the sum of its companies, and a company’s success is the sum of its employees. So we start with the employee. Our mission Isn’t AI going to replace jobs? That’s the belief when people are seen as a cost: fewer of them becomes the efficiency play. We build AI that cleans up the mess around people so their work becomes more valuable. More value from the people you have, not the same value from fewer of them. Read Tomáš’s manifesto Whatever you do, Duvo. We talk through your process, map the first one in a two-week Enterprise trial, then send a proposal with the scope, price, controls and how results are measured. Explore discovery outputs Duvo for Microsoft Access and deployment Private intelligence Developer resources Where Duvo fits Vendor comparison 01 Duvo vs. Scribe Duvo takes the captured process into production. Scribe creates guides and analyses recorded workflows. Duvo combines screen walkthroughs with AI interviews that ask follow-up questions about decisions, exceptions and handoffs. Get your first process map and improvement recommendations in a two-week Enterprise trial, without connecting your systems. Then choose whether Duvo should run that process across APIs, browsers and desktops, with your team controlling approvals. Map one process 02 Duvo vs. Celonis Duvo starts discovery before you connect your systems. Celonis is built around mining business data to find where processes break down. Duvo starts with the people doing the work: AI interviews, screen walkthroughs and existing documents. You can map a process across SAP, spreadsheets and portals without building a data pipeline. Get the first map and improvement recommendations in a two-week Enterprise trial, then decide what to change or automate. Start process discovery 03 Duvo vs. SAP Signavio Duvo captures the process your SAP programme needs. SAP Signavio gives transformation teams a suite for modelling, mining and improving processes. Duvo makes the initial capture easy: your operators show their screens and answer AI follow-up questions, including work outside SAP. Get a reviewed map without connecting to SAP first. Export it as BPMN 2.0 XML for your SI or Signavio team to use in the migration. See the SAP migration offer 04 Duvo vs. ServiceNow Duvo starts with the process your operations team needs fixed. ServiceNow is a natural fit for work already running on its platform. With Duvo, choose a process such as freight audit or invoice reconciliation across the systems you already use. Start from a pre-built module, show us your rules and exceptions, and let Duvo configure the process. Your team approves the actions and reviews the completed work. Explore pre-built solutions 05 Duvo vs. Salesforce Agentforce Duvo runs the work between your ERP, inbox and portals. Agentforce builds on Salesforce data, Flows and integrations such as MuleSoft. Duvo starts with your operational process, whether or not Salesforce is involved. Show how your team handles invoices or orders; Duvo uses existing connections and browser or desktop actions where needed. This reduces the need for new APIs, with system access and approvals agreed upfront. See how Duvo connects and executes 06 Duvo vs. UiPath Duvo gives you a concrete process to put live in weeks. UiPath serves teams building automations and buyers choosing packaged solutions. Duvo gives your operations team a direct route: choose a pre-built module such as Freight Audit, show us the exceptions, and agree the first production outcome. Duvo configures and tests the process with your team. Target go-live in weeks, with the scope and access requirements agreed before starting. Explore Freight Audit 07 Duvo vs. Automation Anywhere Duvo makes the first step a process map. Automation Anywhere offers process discovery, AI-assisted building and packaged automation. With Duvo, your team shows and explains one process, including the judgment behind exceptions. Get the map and improvement recommendations in a two-week Enterprise trial, with no obligation to automate. If you continue, choose a supported module, sized in DPUs (Duvo Processing Units) on one annual agreement, with the scope and volume agreed upfront. Map one process 08 Duvo vs. Camunda ProcessOS Duvo gives you a pre-built operational starting point. Camunda ProcessOS brings AI discovery and deployment to Camunda orchestration and is currently in closed beta. Duvo lets you start with a named module such as Freight Audit or Payables Audit, then adapt it to your systems and approval rules. For a process that needs discovery first, map it in a two-week Enterprise trial and keep the map without buying automation. A DPU (Duvo Processing Unit) is the one unit Duvo is priced in: $1,000 list, sized at roughly 100 hours of human work, covering compute, integrations and intelligence. Free includes a one-off 0.05 DPU. Pro and Business include a monthly DPU allowance. On Enterprise, every automation draws down on one annual agreement. Which products come with each plan? Free, Pro, Business and Enterprise come with Process Intelligence, Automation and Operating Insights, and Quality and evals checks every completed agent run automatically. Plans differ in their Clarity interviews, DPU allowance and concurrency; Enterprise adds SSO, audit logs and priority support. How does annual billing work? Pro and Business can be paid monthly or annually. Annual billing costs 10% less than twelve monthly payments: $2,149 a year for Pro and $7,549 a year for Business. Enterprise contracts are billed annually. What does Enterprise include? Enterprise combines Clarity, from $30k a year with 100 interviews, and one annual agreement measured in DPUs, from $50k. Each automation is sized in DPUs and draws down on the agreement, and you can top up without renegotiating. Enterprise also includes unlimited concurrency, SSO, audit logs, priority support and a forward-deployed engineer. How does Duvo meet enterprise security requirements? Duvo holds SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and ISO 42001, supports GDPR requirements, and operates in line with NIS2. Enterprise adds SSO and audit logs, and Duvo does not train its own or third-party models on customer data. The SOC 2 report and certificates are available on request through the Trust Center. How do we know what an automation is worth before we commit? Clarity maps the process first and surfaces the use cases worth automating. Each automation is then sized in DPUs against the work it takes on, and the proposal states the result it is measured on before you sign. Can we buy Duvo through Azure Marketplace? Yes. Duvo is listed on Azure Marketplace, and purchases there follow the listed or private-offer terms. Marketplace automation plans carry an annual commitment with included runs and a stated charge for additional runs; a per-run price does not by itself mean there is no minimum commitment. How is private deployment priced? The proposal sets out the supported process and model endpoint, setup work, capacity commitment, and who owns operations and support. Dedicated infrastructure is priced as its own line. Get an Enterprise proposal for your processes. Duvo agrees the process, success measure, controls and DPU sizing with you before any work starts.
